I was invited to the unilateral conduct study group of the Japan Competition Law Forum and gave a commentary on the cease-and-desist order issued by the Japan Fair Trade Commission in the MC Data Plus case in December 2024. It was the first administrative order the JFTC issued concerning a cloud service.
